[{'type': 'text', 'text': 'This roadmap outlines the step-by-step execution plan to build the **Responsive YouTube Home Page Clone** as a production-ready micro-frontend, following the technical specifications provided.\n\n### Phase 1: Project Scaffolding & Environment Setup\n*   **Initialize Repository:** Create the project using Vite with the `react-ts` template.\n*   **Monorepo Integration:** Configure the workspace (pnpm) and folder structure under `/packages/ui-youtube`.\n*   **Tailwind CSS Configuration:** \n    *   Install Tailwind v3, PostCSS, and Autoprefixer.\n    *   Configure `tailwind.config.js` with the YouTube-specific dark mode palette (primary background: `#0f0f0f`).\n    *   Enable JIT mode and purge-safe settings.\n*   **TypeScript & Linting:** \n    *   Set up `tsconfig.json` with strict mode and `noImplicitAny`.\n    *   Configure ESLint and Prettier to match the host repo’s standards.\n*   **Test Suite Setup:** \n    *   Install Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress.\n    *   Integrate `axe-core` for automated accessibility testing.\n\n### Phase 2: Data Architecture & Asset Management\n*   **Define Types:** Create `src/types/video.ts` to define the shape of video objects (title, thumbnail, views, timestamp, channel details).\n*   **Mock Data Layer:** Populate `src/data/sampleVideos.ts` with a robust array of dummy data to simulate a real API response.\n*   **Asset Pipeline:** \n    *   Organize placeholder images in `/src/assets`.\n    *   Configure Lucide-React icons for use across the application.\n    *   Set up a system font stack in Tailwind.\n\n### Phase 3: Layout & Global State Implementation\n*   **Root Component:** Build `YouTubeHome.tsx` as the main entry point for the micro-frontend.\n*   **Shell Layout:** Implement the persistent grid/flex layout container.\n*   **State Management:** \n    *   Implement `useState` for `sidebarOpen` (toggled via hamburger menu).\n    *   Implement `useState` for `activeCategory` to handle chip filtering.\n*   **Accessibility Shell:** Ensure the main landmark roles (`<nav>`, `<main>`, `<aside>`) are correctly applied.\n\n### Phase 4: Component Development (Atom to Molecule)\n*   **Navbar Component:** \n    *   Build the search bar with focus states.\n    *   Add icon-only buttons with `aria-label` attributes.\n    *   Implement a fixed-position header.\n*   **Sidebar Component:** \n    *   Create collapsible navigation links.\n    *   Handle responsive behavior (drawer on mobile, mini-sidebar/full-sidebar on desktop).\n*   **Category Chips:** \n    *   Build the horizontal scrolling container.\n    *   Apply the `bg-red-700` active state and hover transitions.\n*   **Video Card Component:** \n    *   Implement 16:9 aspect ratio containers.\n    *   Add "lazy-loading" for thumbnails.\n    *   Apply hover scaling animations (`hover:scale-105`).\n*   **Video Grid:** Build the responsive CSS Grid (1 to 4 columns) that dynamically renders `VideoCard` components.\n\n### Phase 5: Responsive Refinement & Performance Optimization\n*   **Responsive Matrix:** Audit and apply Tailwind breakpoints (`sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl`) to ensure the layout matches the YouTube behavior at every viewport.\n*   **Performance Tuning:** \n    *   Optimize image loading using `loading="lazy"` and WebP formats.\n    *   Ensure the production build gzipped JS is ≤ 150 KB.\n    *   Apply `React.memo` where necessary to prevent unnecessary re-renders in the grid.\n*   **Accessibility Audit:** Manually test keyboard navigation (Tab-index) and focus rings (`focus:outline-2`).\n\n### Phase 6: Testing & Quality Assurance\n*   **Unit Testing:** Write Jest/RTL tests for each component, aiming for ≥ 80% coverage (focusing on conditional rendering and state toggles).\n*   **E2E Testing:** Create Cypress specs to verify:\n    *   Sidebar toggling.\n    *   Category filtering clicks.\n    *   Responsive breakpoint transitions.\n*   **A11y Testing:** Run `cypress-axe` to ensure zero WCAG AA violations.\n\n### Phase 7: Build & CI/CD Integration\n*   **GitHub Actions Workflow:** \n    *   Configure `ci.yml` to run `lint` → `test` → `build`.\n    *   Add a Lighthouse CI step to enforce the LCP ≤ 1s and TTI ≤ 1s budget.\n*   **Micro-Frontend Export:** \n    *   Configure Vite\'s `build` options to output a clean production bundle.\n    *   Test the build as a self-contained module via `vite preview`.\n*   **Documentation:** \n    *   Update `README.md` with setup instructions and a guide on swapping mock data for a real API.\n    *   Finalize the responsive breakpoint table for stakeholders.', 'extras': {'signature': ''}}]
